# Conformance

This document records the executable conformance surface shipped in
`moot-semantics` `v1.0.35`, generated from canonical source commit `4c8673c0330b79bc2163b704cee40bb61985b340`.
It replaces the venue-bootstrap placeholder; package source is loaded.

## Release gates

Run both language suites from the repository root:

```bash
swift test
cargo test --workspace --locked
```

The locked Cargo workspace, root Swift package, and package-level tests are the
executable contract. A release is conforming only when the gates relevant to
its loaded packages pass; this inventory does not stand in for their output.
